name: AIHOT MCP
summary: Remote, read-only MCP server for Chinese-language AI news, keyword searches, story timelines, and dated reports.

agent_access.notes: Uses Streamable HTTP and exposes eight read-only tools. No registration or API key is required. Personal noncommercial, nonprofit noncommercial and internal organizational use is free; external commercial use requires prior written permission under https://aihot.news/terms . Third-party news content has separate rights.
